statement: Concurrent Linux hid-playstation and independent raw SDL Sony output writers can interleave reports to one HID device; exact last-writer effects and physical collisions are unmeasured.

applicability.revision: Linux 4056b3c and SDL 535d80b; hardware/client build not measured
applicability.scope: The kernel writes output reports and SDL independently writes output. A collision is possible by shared transport, not demonstrated. Kernel 1251-1429/SDL 555-700; no physical test.
